## Activity

During January 2023, Hill Counties Health Centre recorded 79 captures. This represents the total capture activity reported for the month. The activity record provides the basis for reviewing image quality and grading outcomes at the site. No additional activity measure is included in this report.

## Image quality

Image quality was suitable for grading for most captures. A total of 2 captures were ungradable, giving an ungradable rate of 2.5. This measure identifies the proportion of reported captures that could not proceed to grading. The result should be considered alongside the overall capture activity for January 2023.

## Grading

Grading identified 10 referable results. These results require attention through the relevant clinical review and follow-up process. The median lag from capture to grading was 2. This provides an indication of the usual time taken for results to pass through the grading process during the reporting period. Overall, the report records activity, image quality and grading outcomes for Hill Counties Health Centre in January 2023.
